ae_item_base_info_dto.detail:
Product Name

Golf spikes

Product Overview

High-quality bamboo golf tees in a flag design, crafted from dun for easy identification on the course. Packaged in a bulk pack of 50, these tees are perfect for golf practice and daily swings.


Product Description

✅ Premium Natural Bamboo Material Durable, eco-friendly and reusable, stronger than plastic tees, withstands multiple rounds of golf without breaking.

✅ 2 Sizes for All Golf Clubs Available in 2-3/4" (70mm) for irons/fairway woods, 3-1/4" (83mm) for drivers, meets all your golfing needs.

✅ Built-in Height Marking System Red & white stripes help you maintain consistent ball height, improve swing accuracy, ideal for beginners and pros.

✅ 10PCS/20PCS/50PCS Bulk Pack, Great Value Large capacity set for daily practice, course play, or sharing with golf buddies, saves your money and time.
